expected: Frontmatter detection must be linear-time on any input (bound the block scan or anchor the lazy quantifier to a non-newline-run, e.g. match the body with a possessive/atomic construct or a two-step splitlines scan) so a malformed atom fails fast instead of hanging the repair verb.
notes: Found during v0.1.72 pre-push security review of the NEW migration. Local-write-triggered DoS (hang), not RCE/data-exposure; not a push blocker. CWE-1333/CWE-400. Redacted.
repro: Place specs/memory/x.md = '---' newline + ('newline' * 50000) with no closing fence, then run the v2->v3 agent-tier-frontmatter migration (dadaia specs upgrade); the migration hangs O(n^2)+ on that file.
title: agent_tier frontmatter regex backtracks catastrophically on a memory atom with an opening --- fence and no closing fence
